summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed, with high release risk. Fleet-wide clearance is unsupported because fleet-doctor has no run, findings, or checks, and operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring/incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unevidenced. Compliance is only a technical baseline with 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown; it is not certification. Decision: keep security-sensitive releases and gated public exposure blocked; permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not claim a clean bill of health. Continue the existing canonical security evidence matrix; do not create duplicate work, retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify configuration, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry.

Evidence triage: fleet TLS has no certificates reported as expiring within 30 days, but TLS configuration and enforcement are not evidenced. No secrets exposure, authentication failure, incident, dependency compromise, isolation failure, or data breach is established; absence of telemetry must remain unknown, not clean. Public compliance checks show some sites passing HTTPS and consent/privacy checks, while the baseline also records 20 failures and 6 unknowns across 61 sites. SearchWoot remains private because security and related launch gates are incomplete.
